findings.title: Current-vs-07-27-baseline delta reflects 18 days / 1263 commits of accumulated work, not just tonight's 6 platform tickets — the improvement is real but not attributable to tonight
findings.evidence: The 07-27 baseline commit is 076a18371da0a09f88b5329bd59611c4bc9536bb. HEAD is 397e3b75a0f62111bc38e25de0378186fd1fde14, 1263 commits later. In that range, the BUN-1..BUN-9 remediation tickets (TRO-197..TRO-202 and the BUN-7/BUN-8 dependency-hygiene PR) were merged: route-level code splitting (25 React.lazy page imports, up from 0), the editor/Tiptap/Yjs/highlight.js/emoji-picker stacks moved behind dynamic imports, and web/vite.config.ts gained manualChunks vendor splitting. Those fixes are the dominant driver of every reduction below, not tonight's six tickets.
findings.hypothesis: n/a — this is a scoping note, not a defect.
findings.estimatedImpact: The 07-27 baseline was correct as a Part-1 comparison point per PLUGFORGE.MD Section 6 ('existing baseline files are the comparison source'), so the gate check below is valid and passes. But 'has the bundle grown because of tonight's tickets' is a different, narrower question this comparison alone cannot answer — see BUN-COMPARE-2 for the isolated measurement.

findings.title: Tonight's six platform tickets contributed one new lazy-loaded route (~1.2 kB gzip) to web/ and zero bytes from sdk/
findings.location: git diff c1caa61..397e3b7 -- web/ (3 files changed: web/src/main.tsx +13, web/src/pages/OAuthDeviceVerify.tsx +147 new file, web/vite.config.ts +8/-2)
findings.evidence: c1caa61 (2026-08-13 14:13:14 -0500) is the last commit before tonight's session; 58 commits landed 2026-08-14 00:5x-02:33. `git diff --stat c1caa61..HEAD -- web/` shows exactly 3 files touched, all part of PF-106's frontend half (OAuthDeviceVerify.tsx is registered as `React.lazy(() => import('@/pages/OAuthDeviceVerify')...)` in main.tsx — confirmed route-split, not eager). The vite.config.ts change only extends a dev/preview-server CSP middleware path list (configureServer/configurePreviewServer — does not run in `vite build`, zero production-bundle effect). Its emitted chunk in the current build is assets/OAuthDeviceVerify-BaIljLCK.js: 3.31 kB raw / 1.22 kB gzip, and it is NOT among the 4 files in the entry closure (confirmed via measure.mjs and cross-checked against web/dist/index.html's actual script/modulepreload tags) — so it adds 0 bytes to the initial-load payload. `grep -rn "@ship/sdk" web/src` and `grep -n sdk web/package.json` both return zero matches: the new sdk/ workspace package is not imported by web at all.
findings.hypothesis: n/a — directly observed via git diff and grep, not inferred.
findings.estimatedImpact: Tonight's frontend footprint is +3.31 kB raw / +1.22 kB gzip to the total bundle (0.15% raw / 0.19% gzip of the current 2163.97/645.56 kB total) and +0 kB to the initial-load bundle. Nowhere close to the +/-10% budget on any axis. OAuth core, the public API v1 router, the OpenAPI generator, and the rate-limit exemption middleware are all api/ (backend) changes with no web/ footprint; the new sdk/ package is a standalone workspace member web does not consume.
